login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Authenticate to reach the control plane.
login.footer: Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity.

language.title: Choose the instance language
language.lead: This is the language of the panel, its notifications and its audit log. It applies to every user.
language.note: You can only change it later from the command line, with a clear warning.

account.title: Create the administrator
account.lead: This account owns the instance. Additional users and roles arrive with the access milestone.
account.instanceNameHint: Shown in the browser title and on the sign-in screen.
account.usernameHint: 2–32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.
account.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Length beats complexity.

dashboard.title: Dashboards
dashboard.lead: Arrange widgets per user or share a layout with the team.
dashboard.emptyLead: Dashboards become useful once a connector is live. The grid is already laid out for the widgets that follow.

schematic.title: Signal path
schematic.lead: The browser never talks to your infrastructure. One poller per connector feeds a shared cache, which is pushed to every client.

connect.title: No connections yet
connect.lead: Pterodactyl, Docker, Proxmox, Portainer and any REST API will plug in here.

resources.title: All resources
resources.lead: Every server, container and virtual machine from every connector in one table.

empty.title: Nothing to list
empty.lead: Resources appear as soon as a connector reports them. Actions, consoles and files follow the capability flags of each connector.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lead: Instance settings, users, roles and the audit trail.

instance.title: Instance
instance.name: Name
instance.localeNote: Fixed per instance. Change it with the CLI command admin set-locale.

users.title: Users and roles
users.lead: RBAC, OIDC providers and group mappings arrive with the access milestone.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Logins and control actions are already recorded as message keys. The viewer lands with the access milestone.

notFound.title: No such page
notFound.lead: The route does not exist. It may have moved with a later milestone.

errors.request.invalid: The request was rejected. Check the values and try again.
errors.request.not_found: The requested resource does not exist.
errors.request.csrf: Your session could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.auth.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {retry_after} seconds.
errors.auth.session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.setup.invalid: Some values are invalid. Check the highlighted field.
errors.password.too_short: The password is too short. Use at least 10 characters.
errors.password.too_common: That password is too common or contains your account name.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. The event was logged.
